note: Round parts: revolves and circles, where three.js needs its own lathe and cylinder arithmetic. Each stage lists its exact boxes.

where.plain: Write it as scene.mjs in this folder: its default export is a function taking no arguments that returns a three.js Object3D holding one named Mesh per part (three is installed; import it from 'three'). Name each mesh exactly as the part is named below. Node can import scene.mjs, so check your work by running it.
where.sleipnir: Build it in a new Environment called "Bench", using the instructions in .claude/commands/sculpt.md. Name each part exactly as it is named below.

stages.name: build
stages.prompt:
Model a round table with things on it. Y is up, the floor is Y = 0, and it is centered on X = 0 and Z = 0.
- "Table": a disc of radius 0.5 and thickness 0.04, its top surface at Y = 0.75.
- "Stem": a cylinder of radius 0.04 from the floor up to the underside of the Table.
- "Bowl": a solid of revolution about the vertical line X = 0, Z = 0, standing on the table. Its outline is straight: radius 0.06 at the bottom, widening to radius 0.15 at the top, 0.08 tall.
- "Cone lamp": a solid cone standing on the table with its axis at X = 0.3, Z = 0, base radius 0.1, height 0.25, point up.
Curves should be smooth enough that the extents are right to within a millimeter.

stages.name: wider table
stages.prompt: Make the Table radius 0.6. Its thickness and height stay the same.

stages.name: taller bowl
stages.prompt: Make the Bowl 0.1 tall instead of 0.08, its base staying on the table and its radii unchanged.

stages.name: move lamp
stages.prompt: Move the Cone lamp so its axis is at X = -0.3. Nothing else moves.
